newsitem.title: USA: Seaway crude pipeline tariff to rise to 75 cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Seaway crude pipeline tariff to rise to 75 cts/bbl.

text.p: The tariff on the Seaway crude oil pipeline system will increase to 75 cents a barrel effective August 2, a spokesman for operator ARCO Pipe Line, a unit of Atlantic Richfield Co, said on Wednesday.
The current tariff of 60 cents a barrel went into effect on July 1. The tariff was formerly 50 cents effective November 23, 1996, and 75 cents prior to that.
The Seaway pipeline system, which runs from the Texas Gulf Coast to Cushing, Oklahoma, is owned by ARCO and Phillips Petroleum Co.
The system has a design capacity of 430,000 barrels per day (bpd) on two lines, a 270,000 bpd 30-inch line and a 160,000 bpd 20-inch line.
